notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340365/02e229230e0a9680a540b3ebe41019a46ed1bc20.png[/img]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
When you lose on a map, you now receive 50% of the essence you gained.
Upgrading the skill tree gives up to 21% more essence.
For every 3rd wave victory, you receive 19% more essence.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
Fixed an issue with the essence received when returning from the shop via portal.

notes.title: Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340365/02e229230e0a9680a540b3ebe41019a46ed1bc20.png[/img]
Greetings,

We would like to announce some important changes that are
preparation for the update 1.1.0 that will take place around March.

1. We added achievements but these will not be available yet. We added them for the purpose of carrying out tests for their implementation in version 1.1.0

2. We activated the steam cloud, it is already functional although it currently has an unnecessary internal unity function which will be deactivated for update 1.1.0

3. We added temporary localizations in French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese for the steam page.

4. We are planning to make temporary localizations for the game in the same languages.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.0.2

-The "max reached stats" indicator was not displaying correctly.

-When fusing tier 2 and 3 crests in the battlefield, these were not unlocking in the library.

-Some words were missing in the in-game texts.

-When changing the language within the library, the language was not updating.

-In the shop, the reward menu did not support numbers greater than 3 digits.

-When returning through the portal, the reward value was calculating incorrectly.

-Tree upgrades were not resetting between saved files.
